### ⚠️ What I changed from the brief

- **Only the pictures moved; the records stayed.** The brief said to `git rm` the month folders. But the tracked records are only 52 MB, and removing them would free nothing in `.git`. It would also hide two months from search and break old task links.
- **734 pictures (96 MB) stayed on C:.** These are the ones a page shows when it opens. The first run moved them too, and one September page broke. That broken page would also have failed any later merge that touches September. They are copied on E: as well.
